original_question: For the same incompressible Jeffreys-type viscoelastic fluid model with div v = 0, v|∂Ω = 0, motion equation ∂v/∂t + Σ_i v_i ∂v/∂x_i − Div σ + ∇p = f, and constitutive law σ + λ1 Dσ/Dt = 2η(E + λ2 DE/Dt), are weak solutions unique without restrictions on the coefficients, external force, or initial data, in dimensions n ≥ 2?
target_in_paper: The draft is aiming at the paper’s weak-solution uniqueness open problem for the initial-boundary value problem for an incompressible Jeffreys fluid: whether the weak solution produced in the natural existence class is unique, as opposed to the paper’s only positive Serrin-type conditional uniqueness result in 3D. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/0911.2206))
correct_elements: Your draft correctly identifies the Jeffreys incompressible flow model, the no-slip and divergence-free constraints, the substantial-derivative constitutive law, and the fact that the relevant issue is uniqueness of weak solutions rather than mere existence. ([nzdr.ru](https://www.nzdr.ru/data/media/biblio/kolxoz/P/PC/PCfm/Zvyagin%20V.G.%2C%20Vorotnikov%20D.A.%20Topological%20Approximation%20Methods%20for%20Evolutionary%20Problems%20of%20Nonlinear%20Hydrodynamics%20%28de%20Gruyter%2C%202008%29%28ISBN%203110202220%29%28245s%29_PCfm_.pdf))
missing_details: The paper’s natural spatial scope is an arbitrary domain Ω⊂R^n with n=2 or 3 (possibly unbounded), not general n≥2. ([nzdr.ru](https://www.nzdr.ru/data/media/biblio/kolxoz/P/PC/PCfm/Zvyagin%20V.G.%2C%20Vorotnikov%20D.A.%20Topological%20Approximation%20Methods%20for%20Evolutionary%20Problems%20of%20Nonlinear%20Hydrodynamics%20%28de%20Gruyter%2C%202008%29%28ISBN%203110202220%29%28245s%29_PCfm_.pdf))

The coefficients are not left unrestricted in the model statement: η>0 and 0<λ2<λ1 are built into the setup. ([nzdr.ru](https://www.nzdr.ru/data/media/biblio/kolxoz/P/PC/PCfm/Zvyagin%20V.G.%2C%20Vorotnikov%20D.A.%20Topological%20Approximation%20Methods%20for%20Evolutionary%20Problems%20of%20Nonlinear%20Hydrodynamics%20%28de%20Gruyter%2C%202008%29%28ISBN%203110202220%29%28245s%29_PCfm_.pdf))

The data class from the existence theorem is part of the precise question: f∈L^2(0,T;V*), a∈H, and σ0∈W^{-1}_2(Ω;S^{n×n}). ([nzdr.ru](https://www.nzdr.ru/data/media/biblio/kolxoz/P/PC/PCfm/Zvyagin%20V.G.%2C%20Vorotnikov%20D.A.%20Topological%20Approximation%20Methods%20for%20Evolutionary%20Problems%20of%20Nonlinear%20Hydrodynamics%20%28de%20Gruyter%2C%202008%29%28ISBN%203110202220%29%28245s%29_PCfm_.pdf))

There is a compatibility condition on the initial data, namely σ0-2η(λ2/λ1)E(a)∈L^2(Ω;S^{n×n}), which your draft omits. ([nzdr.ru](https://www.nzdr.ru/data/media/biblio/kolxoz/P/PC/PCfm/Zvyagin%20V.G.%2C%20Vorotnikov%20D.A.%20Topological%20Approximation%20Methods%20for%20Evolutionary%20Problems%20of%20Nonlinear%20Hydrodynamics%20%28de%20Gruyter%2C%202008%29%28ISBN%203110202220%29%28245s%29_PCfm_.pdf))

To be stand-alone, the weak-solution class must be stated explicitly: v∈L^2(0,T;V)∩C_w([0,T];H), vt∈L^1(0,T;V*), and σ∈L^2(0,T;L^2(Ω;S^{n×n}))∩C_w([0,T];H^{-1}(Ω;S^{n×n})). ([nzdr.ru](https://www.nzdr.ru/data/media/biblio/kolxoz/P/PC/PCfm/Zvyagin%20V.G.%2C%20Vorotnikov%20D.A.%20Topological%20Approximation%20Methods%20for%20Evolutionary%20Problems%20of%20Nonlinear%20Hydrodynamics%20%28de%20Gruyter%2C%202008%29%28ISBN%203110202220%29%28245s%29_PCfm_.pdf))

The notation E(v)=1/2(∇v+∇v^T) and the symmetric stress space S^{n×n} should be made explicit. ([nzdr.ru](https://www.nzdr.ru/data/media/biblio/kolxoz/P/PC/PCfm/Zvyagin%20V.G.%2C%20Vorotnikov%20D.A.%20Topological%20Approximation%20Methods%20for%20Evolutionary%20Problems%20of%20Nonlinear%20Hydrodynamics%20%28de%20Gruyter%2C%202008%29%28ISBN%203110202220%29%28245s%29_PCfm_.pdf))

The nearby precise reformulation uses the transformed stress variable τ:=σ-2η(λ2/λ1)E(v); this is the paper-faithful equivalent formulation you are currently not using. ([nzdr.ru](https://www.nzdr.ru/data/media/biblio/kolxoz/P/PC/PCfm/Zvyagin%20V.G.%2C%20Vorotnikov%20D.A.%20Topological%20Approximation%20Methods%20for%20Evolutionary%20Problems%20of%20Nonlinear%20Hydrodynamics%20%28de%20Gruyter%2C%202008%29%28ISBN%203110202220%29%28245s%29_PCfm_.pdf))

The review does not present unconditional uniqueness; it only records conditional uniqueness in 3D under extra Serrin-type assumptions and an energy inequality. A faithful research question should therefore ask whether those extra hypotheses can be removed. ([nzdr.ru](https://www.nzdr.ru/data/media/biblio/kolxoz/P/PC/PCfm/Zvyagin%20V.G.%2C%20Vorotnikov%20D.A.%20Topological%20Approximation%20Methods%20for%20Evolutionary%20Problems%20of%20Nonlinear%20Hydrodynamics%20%28de%20Gruyter%2C%202008%29%28ISBN%203110202220%29%28245s%29_PCfm_.pdf))
refined_question: Let Ω⊂R^n be an arbitrary domain, with n∈{2,3}, let T>0, η>0, and 0<λ2<λ1, and assume f∈L^2(0,T;V*), a∈H, and σ0∈W^{-1}_2(Ω;S^{n×n}) satisfy σ0-2η(λ2/λ1)E(a)∈L^2(Ω;S^{n×n}), where E(v)=1/2(∇v+∇v^T). For the incompressible Jeffreys initial-boundary value problem vt+(v·∇)v-Divσ+∇p=f, σ+λ1(σt+(v·∇)σ)=2η(E(v)+λ2(E(v)t+(v·∇)E(v))), divv=0, v|∂Ω=0, v(0)=a, σ(0)=σ0, does the weak solution given by the existence theorem, in the natural class v∈L^2(0,T;V)∩Cw([0,T];H), vt∈L^1(0,T;V*), σ∈L^2(0,T;L^2(Ω;S^{n×n}))∩Cw([0,T];H^{-1}(Ω;S^{n×n})), have to be unique, i.e. can one remove the additional 3D Serrin-type assumptions used in the conditional uniqueness theorem? ([nzdr.ru](https://www.nzdr.ru/data/media/biblio/kolxoz/P/PC/PCfm/Zvyagin%20V.G.%2C%20Vorotnikov%20D.A.%20Topological%20Approximation%20Methods%20for%20Evolutionary%20Problems%20of%20Nonlinear%20Hydrodynamics%20%28de%20Gruyter%2C%202008%29%28ISBN%203110202220%29%28245s%29_PCfm_.pdf))
equivalent_formulation: Equivalently, after introducing τ:=σ-2η(λ2/λ1)E(v) and passing to the paper’s transformed (v,τ)-system, is uniqueness true in the corresponding weak class without assuming in 3D that v∈L^8(0,T;L^4(Ω)^n) and τ∈L^4(0,T;W^{1,4}(Ω;S^{n×n})) (together with the energy inequality)? ([nzdr.ru](https://www.nzdr.ru/data/media/biblio/kolxoz/P/PC/PCfm/Zvyagin%20V.G.%2C%20Vorotnikov%20D.A.%20Topological%20Approximation%20Methods%20for%20Evolutionary%20Problems%20of%20Nonlinear%20Hydrodynamics%20%28de%20Gruyter%2C%202008%29%28ISBN%203110202220%29%28245s%29_PCfm_.pdf))
justification: I interpret your draft as targeting the review’s weak-solution uniqueness problem because the paper is explicitly a review of known results and main unsolved problems for Jeffreys-type motion equations, and the detailed treatment by the same authors makes clear that: (i) existence is established in a specific weak class for the substantial-derivative Jeffreys IBVP; (ii) the natural transformed variable is τ=σ-2η(λ2/λ1)E(v); and (iii) uniqueness is only proved conditionally in 3D under Serrin-type extra regularity, while general uniqueness remains open. Your draft captures the model and the broad uniqueness theme, but it broadens the dimension range, suppresses the data spaces and compatibility condition, and does not register that the paper’s actual sharp issue is whether the additional conditional-uniqueness hypotheses can be dropped. ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/0911.2206))
